submission_method.value: Electronic submission via the bidding system at https://medicinehat.bidsandtenders.ca
submission_method.quote: the onus is on the proponent to create a bidding system vendor account and register as a plan taker for the opportunity at https://medicinehat.bidsandtenders.ca

scope_of_deliverables.value: The City of Medicine Hat is procuring a Learning Management System (LMS) to support training and development. The scope includes assessments, a learning catalog, learning paths, certifications, and integrations with systems like Azure AD, M365, and Unit4.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: Assessments & Quizzes: Create, deliver and manage assessments, quizzes, and surveys. Learning Catalog & Search: Browsable catalog, tags, filters, keyword search; configurable enrollment flows and approvals. Learning Path: Create learning paths either mandated or recommended (optional). Certifications & Compliance: Issuance and management of certifications... Integrations: integrate with other systems (e.g. content authoring tools, third-party apps like Microsoft Viva, SharePoint, Email/Outlook, Unit4 Enterprise Resource Planning System/HRIS and Finance System)

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: The City will review the proposals to determine whether the mandatory technical requirements as set out in Appendix D (RFP Particulars), Section E have been met. evaluation_criteria.quote: Technical Capability (Appendix E) – Initial | 50 | 35; Total Points | 130; Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score.

minimum_score_threshold.quote: Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold.

pricing_structure.value: Relative pricing formula: (Proponent's Price / Lowest Price) x 100 = Percentage. Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score.
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the pricing form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has submitted a proposal for, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: (Proponent's Price / Lowest Price) x 100 = Percentage. Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score.
